What can Saarth do today, and what’s next?

Grow what you have.
Build what’s next.

One platform for the money you already have and the ideas you might act on. It brings every account in, lets you see and question it, and tests new ideas on history before they touch real money. The list keeps growing.

Bring data in from anywhere you invest.

MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is a standard way for apps to talk to a service’s own connector. Saarth uses it to read holdings, and only to read them.
